text:
deploy-bot: post-deploy synthetic alert: ap-southeast-1 embed-service tag v2026-03-21-quant rolled 100% -> increased errors on /v1/embeddings (service-level probe)

priya: saw the alert on pager. synth shows p95=1300ms, error_rate=5.2% (1m window). normal p95 ~120ms.

synth-bot: probe summary:
```
probe: embed-quant-v2 (ap-southeast-1) -> 502/503 upstream_alloc_fail
hosts_healthy: 1/6
latency_p95: 1300ms
error_rate: 5.2%
```

priya: logs show runtime stack: `kv_cache_alloc -> alloc_fail -> return_oom` then proxy emitting 503. seems to correlate with long-context embed jobs (>6k tokens) and concurrent warmups.

tom: could be new kernel/allocator picks in this build. suspect quant kernelexec path holds on to extra scratch memory.

lydia: recommend isolate region with split pin; avoid global rollback. we can do a staggered migration back to fp16 variant in APAC, keep EMEA/US on quant for now.

priya: propose 15% canary to fp16 then validate 12m, then 100% if green. command: 
```
releases pin --service embed-service --region ap-southeast-1 --variant embed-fp16-stable --split 15
```

deploy-bot: change requested, id=chg-99321. applying in ~20s.

synth-bot: immediate 1m window after split:
- quant (85%): p95=1180ms, errors=4.7%
- fp16 (15%): p95=150ms, errors=0.3%

ops-oncall: can we tighten the canary to 10%? less blast if fp16 behaves. also will watch prod traces for real user impact.

lydia: 10% ok. update command: `deploy-router set-split --service embed-service --region ap-southeast-1 --weights embed-fp16-stable=10,embed-quant-v2=90`

deploy-bot: routing change applied, id=chg-99322.

priya: after 10m canary, fp16 stable, quant still noisy. recommend expand to 100% on fp16 for the region.

ops-oncall: expanding to 100% now: `deploy-router set-split --service embed-service --region ap-southeast-1 --weights embed-fp16-stable=100`

deploy-bot: routing change id=chg-99323 applied. ap-southeast-1 -> 100% embed-fp16-stable.

synth-bot: post-switch (3m): p95=140ms, errors=0.12% (sample 3m).

tom: creating ticket OPS-4599: postdeploy ap-southeast-1 quant path memory regression. include alloc traces, kernel flag diffs, and synthetic probe timelines.

priya: please add a short release note for v2026-03-21: regional pin in APAC for embed-service due to quant variant alloc failures; rollouts will resume after kernel/allocator bisect.

lydia: schedule kernel-quant bisect in tomorrow's APAC change window (03:00 UTC). action owners: tom (kernel), infra/serving (allocator knobs), priya (synth verification).

ops-oncall: monitoring set to higher sensitivity for next 120m, forwarding any anomalies here. initial 30m looks clear.

priya: thanks all — avoided global rollback and preserved rollout momentum elsewhere. follow-up: try reproducer with long-context concurrent load in staging and run the allocator stress harness before re-roll.
